summary: Tested the Direct Photo Uploads feature (admin+editor squad group photos, home pop-up image). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests green covering auth gating, mime+size validation, upload→serve round-trip, editor upload, 404, plus admin tabs regression. Frontend: Admin upload→save→public /squads image visible (200 image/png, naturalWidth 1375) → remove→save→cleared verified end-to-end. Pop-up upload also round-trips to home page. All test data cleaned up (U-14 group_photo='', popup enabled=false, title/message restored, image_url=''). FOUND CRITICAL BUG: editor saving a squad returns HTTP 500 (ResponseValidationError) because PUT /api/admin/squads/{id} declares response_model=SquadOut but returns {'pending': True} for non-admin users. The pending change IS persisted (visible in Approvals) but the UI shows a red 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' instead of the expected 'Submitted — an admin must approve it' info message. Reject button in Approvals tab works and cleans up the pending entry.

critical.issue: response_model=SquadOut incompatible with {'pending': True} return for non-admin users -> FastAPI ResponseValidationError (500). Breaks the editor approval flow for squad saves (with OR without photos). Fix options: (a) remove response_model and return Dict/Union, (b) wrap return in Union[SquadOut, PendingResponse], (c) move the pending-change creation + response ordering so admin path returns SquadOut and non-admin returns a plain dict without the decorator-level validator. Note: popup PUT at line 855 likely has the same latent issue — please audit.

minor.issue: Backend sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400' but the Cloudflare/K8s ingress overrides it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Images still serve 200 image/*, but client-side caching is lost. Preview-env artefact — probably fine for prod but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Save squad' as editor, UI shows red 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' instead of the expected pending-queued info message. Root cause is the backend 500 above — fix the backend and this disappears.

issues: Duplicate data-testid values across Men's and Women's wings: 'squad-photo-u19-input', 'squad-photo-u23-input', 'squad-photo-seniors-input' each appear twice (same for -upload / -remove / -preview / -progress). The slug used for testPrefix must include the wing to be unique (e.g. squad-photo-women-u19-input). Playwright will match the first; strict mode would fail. Low priority but a test-hygiene issue.

action_items: FIX BACKEND: PUT /api/admin/squads/{squad_id} — remove response_model=SquadOut OR change return type to Union so {'pending': True} validates for non-admin. Audit PUT /api/admin/popup for the same pattern.
FIX FRONTEND: PhotoUpload testPrefix for Women's Wing squads collides with Men's — include wing in the testid slug.

Optional: switch PhotoUpload progress-indicator / preview to use more robust testid structure that includes an element so e2e tests can await a visible img.src — current preview uses background-image CSS which isn't matched by [data-testid$='preview'] img.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 811 — @api_router.put('/admin/squads/{squad_id}', response_model=SquadOut) is incompatible with the non-admin pending-change path on line 830 (returns {'pending': True}). This has been broken since the approval workflow landed; FastAPI's response validation is strict.

Upload endpoint streams the entire file into memory before size-checking (await file.read()). A malicious client can send a 100MB multipart body and still OOM the worker before the 5MB check. Consider checking Content-Length header first OR using an incremental read with a byte counter.

db.files is written but never read for permission checks on GET /api/files/{path} — any logged-in path owner (uploaded_by) is lost; is_deleted soft-delete is defined but no admin endpoint exists to delete / list uploads. Not blocking, but means the storage will accumulate orphans whenever a squad photo is replaced or removed (old /api/files/... entries stay 'live').

success_rate.frontend: 80% — admin squad+popup upload flows pass end-to-end; editor squad save flow fails due to backend bug.

rca of the issue: RCA — Editor squad save returns 500 'Something went wrong': File /app/backend/server.py, line 811 declares the endpoint with response_model=SquadOut (a Pydantic model requiring id, age_group, label fields). When user.role != 'admin', the handler at line 830 returns `{'pending': True}` — a dict missing all three required fields. FastAPI runs response serialization via that model and raises ResponseValidationError (3 validation errors: id/age_group/label missing), which the exception handler returns as HTTP 500. Reproduction: login as editor, PUT /api/admin/squads/<any-valid-id> with any body -> 500. Mitigation (minimal diff): change the decorator to `@api_router.put('/admin/squads/{squad_id}')` (drop response_model) OR declare `response_model=Union[SquadOut, Dict[str, bool]]` with `response_model_exclude_unset=True`. Side effect to be aware of: the pending-change document IS created before the handler returns, so a failed save still queues an Approval request — the DB write is NOT rolled back by the response validation error.
